record.title: Evaluate ADC validation and select the next unsatisfied initialization dependency
record.intent: Continue static-first subsystem recovery from the witnessed stock boundary.
requirements: Compare static prediction and actual stock evidence; distinguish synthetic logging responses from software state and physical semantics. Preserve any negative result and reconcile before changes.

On success inspect the next stock initialization routine statically and identify externally unsatisfied reads, asynchronous state or environment dependencies. Do not resume into or supply responses for the next subsystem in this batch.
Draft a small evidence-supported successor batch or record a precise limitation. Run plan, inspect mutations, admit against the expected revision and commit and push tasking before execution.
acceptance: The stock prediction is evaluated and an evidence-supported bounded successor or limitation is committed and pushed.
